status: Fixed before formal data; exploratory seen-seed screen only
quality: Two-sided 95% Wilson upper per calibration source; no pooling; cal24 only at batch1, cal0 elsewhere after strict reuse checks
eligibility: Actual filter bytes <= floor(real_n*cap/8) and current source Wilson upper <= threshold. Smaller allocations remain eligible. Report caller scratch separately; do not silently count it as bitmap or hide it.
leaders: Independently minimize each metric within each ownership class, retained native union, all native union, all external union and all retained union. Preserve every exact tie and null/no-comparable outcome. Do not transfer a leader between query or build contracts.
alternatives: Retain every row under every cap/threshold view, including over-budget, quality-ineligible, slower and incomparable outcomes; keep actual bytes, scratch bytes, counts and every trial vector.
paired_api: Keep raw_batched_public/raw_visible_public ratio for all786 rows and all eight samples per vector; greater than1 favors visible. No generic identity-copy phase exists.
fixed_default: Compare all fixed K1..12 against same-size/requested-budget Fastbloom0.17 default, retaining all failures and equal-byte assertion; this is not same hashing as new fastbloom-rs.
scope: Seed42 training only, no seed-independent inference or significance claim. Eight repeats reuse one bitmap/input and are not independent quality samples. Across budgets use separate-process scope; no older CPU3 timing normalization.
precision: A cal24 upper bound crossing a target is finite-resolution gate failure, not permanent algorithmic disqualification. Retain borderline competitors for later prespecified uniform confirmation.
poppy: Absent from this immutable executable. Complete committed Poppy leaders and both natural byte8/typed-u64 APIs must be considered under a new common raw-only contract before any broader strongest-external claim. No transfer of old shared-prehash latencies or quality.
